entry.title: South African minister tells universities to move from AI debate to decisions on teaching and research
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwiNkomfa yesine yeMfundo ePhakamileyo yeUniversities South Africa, ngomhla wesi-7 kuOkthobha 2026, uMphathiswa wezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, uButi Manamela, uxelele iiyunivesithi ukuba i-AI yenza umsebenzi wazo ophambili, ukufundisa ukucinga okunzulu nokuthatha uxanduva ngolwazi, ube ngxamiseke ngakumbi, kungabi nganeno, kuba iinkqubo ze-AI zinako ukudala umxholo ngokuzithemba ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa ukuba uyinyaniso. Uthi umbuzo wokwenyani ugqithisa ekubeni nje abafundi basebenzisa i-AI kwimisebenzi yesikolo, ubandakanya nokuba ngubani owenza le tekhnoloji, ziilwimi namava abantu ezibonakaliswa yiyo, ngubani olawula iziseko zobugcisa, nokuba ngubani oxhamlayo. Ukhuthaze ukuba izifundo zobuntu nezentlalo zisebenze ndawonye nobunjineli kunye nezinzululwazi zemvelo, ekujongeni iimpembelelo zayo ekucaleni, emandleni, nakwimisebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, umphathiswa karhulumente obeka icebo elicacileyo, ngokufundisa, ngovavanyo kunye nobuchule bophando, kunokuba abe ngumxholo wengxoxo jikelele, unika iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika igunya elicacileyo lokuthatha amanyathelo.

South African Government News Agency (SAnews) · National government news agency

entry.title: UNESCO study finds 87% of Latin American and Caribbean universities already use AI, but only 26% have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Iphepha losebenzo lwe-UNESCO IESALC, elidityaniswe nelwe-UNU-IAS, elaphonononga iziko zemfundo ephakamileyo 200 kumazwe 19 aseLatin America nakuCaribbean phakathi kuAgasti noku-Okthobha 2025, lifumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-87 sele zisebenzisa i-AI kumba omnye ubuncinane, ekhokelwa yindlela yokufundisa nokufunda (iipesenti ezingama-74) nophando (iipesenti ezingama-57), ngeli xesha iipesenti ezingama-26 kuphela zinesicwangciso esisemthethweni se-AI, kwaye iipesenti ezingama-55 azinalo nanye uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olunikezelwe kwi-AI. Ukusetyenziswa kunye nolawulo zombini zilandela uhlobo lweziko ngokusondeleyo: iipesenti ezingama-84 zeziko eziphantsi kwabucala ezingazimiseli ngenzuzo zisebenzisa i-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-68 zeziko karhulumente, kwaye iipesenti ezingama-17 zeziko karhulumente zichaza ukungabikho kakade koqeqesho lwabasebenzi, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-3 zeziko zabucala ezingazimiseli ngenzuzo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI enengqiqo, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI sele kusasazeke ngelixa ulawulo olusemthethweni lusemva kakhulu, kwaye ngokungalinganiyo phakathi kweziko karhulumente nezabucala, kufana nomsantsa wolawulo i-Wits AHEAD eyibonayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi ngobubanzi bawo.

UNESCO IESALC and UNU-IAS, reported by Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO/UNU-IAS working paper

entry.title: UTeach survey finds STEM teacher-training staff cautiously optimistic about AI but wary of integrity and bias risks
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabasebenzi beakademi, abalawuli nabasebenzi 57 abasuka kwiinkqubo 31 zokuqeqesha ootitshala beSTEM kwiikholeji neeyunivesithi 54 kuMzantsi weMelika, lufumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-77 zivumelana ukuba i-AI inamandla okuchaphazela umsebenzi wazo ngokuhle, ngeli xesha iipesenti ezingama-61 zizichaza njengabasebenzisi abazimiseleyo. Iipesenti ezingama-63 zisahlala zikhathazeke ngemiceli mngeni, ikakhulu ingqibelelo yezemfundo (iipesenti ezingama-42) kunye nenkolelo-ethekelelweyo yokuziphatha (iipesenti ezingama-21). Iipesenti ezingama-70 zichonge imfuneko yoqeqesho olongezelelweyo; iipesenti ezingama-79 zabafundisi sele zisebenzisa i-AI kwizifundo zabo, ikakhulu ekucwangciseni iileksoni nasekuyileni uvavanyo, kunokuba kube luphando olunzulu lwedatha yeSTEM.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI nohlalutyo kwiSTEM nemfundo yootitshala, umsantsa phakathi kwabasebenzi abasele bazama i-AI nesakhelo esimanyene, esisekelwe kuphando, abathi basilele kuso, ufana ncam noluhlobo lwenkokheli eyilungeleleneyo iinkqubo zokuqeqesha ootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi eziya kuyidinga nazo.

The UTeach Institute, The University of Texas at Austin · University research institute report

entry.title: Systematic review finds no existing framework yet addresses the ethical and instructional challenges of AI in STEM teaching
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucokisekileyo olwenziwe ngabaphandi be-Wentworth Institute of Technology kunye ne-University of New Haven luvavanye izakhelo ezisungulwe kudala, ezifana ne-TPACK, i-SAMR, i-ADDIE kunye ne-Universal Design for Learning, ngokuzithelekisa neemodeli zokwazi i-AI kunye nemigaqo yokusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela enengqiqo, ukubona indlela ezixhasa ngayo abafundisi beSTEM kwindlela yabo yokufundisa. Luye lufumanise ukuba akukho nesinye sezi zakhelo esele sijongana nemiceli mngeni yobungcali, yokuziphatha, kunye nokufundisa ekusetyenziseni i-AI kwimfundo yeSTEM, kwaye ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ze-AI kukhawuleza ngaphezu kwenkokheli ecwangcisiweyo yezokufundisa, nto leyo ekhokelela kwindlela yokwenza esekelwe ezixhobeni, kunokuba isekelwe kwisakhelo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kuluphawu lwe-Wits AHEAD olumalunga ne-AI nohlalutyo kwiSTEM nemfundo yootitshala, ukufunyaniswa kokuba akukho sakhelo sokufundisa sikhoyo esigubungela imiceli mngeni yokuziphatha nokufundisa ye-AI, komeleza isizathu sokuba iqela lenze umsebenzi walo wokudibanisa i-AI ngendlela enengqiqo, ekhethekileyo kwiSTEM.

American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE), North East Section Conference · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: More universities end Turnitin contracts as concerns mount
entry.summary:
I-Times Higher Education ibika ukuba i-Newcastle University kunye ne-University of Westminster zidibene ne-University of Southampton ekuphelisweni kwezivumelwano zazo nenkampani yokufumanisa ukukopa i-Turnitin, emva kokuba yacebisa utshintsho kwiilayisensi olwanga lwavumela umsebenzi wabafundi ukuba usetyenziswe ukuqeqesha izixhobo ze-AI. I-Newcastle yachaphazela ngqo lo mgaqo wedatha; i-Westminster yathi isixhobo sokukhangela ukukopa se-Turnitin 'besingasebenzi kakuhle' kumbhalo obhalwe yi-AI, kwaye isixhobo sayo sokufumanisa i-AI sinomngcipheko 'owaziwayo wezimpendulo ezizizo ezingezizo'. I-Southampton yodwa yahlawula i-Turnitin i-£87,621 kunyaka omnye, phakathi kwabafundi abangaphezu kwe-17,000 abaqalayo kunye nabangama-8,000 abaqhubekayo neziqu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, lo mba ubonisa ukuba ii-yunivesithi ziqalisa ukulinganisa ulawulo lwedatha kunye nokuthembeka kwenyani kwezixhobo zokufumanisa i-AI ngokumelene neendleko, kunokuba zithathe isivumelwano sokukhangela ukukopa njengembopheleleko engenakuguqulwa.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Prepare students for post-graduation AI judgement challenges
entry.summary:
I-University World News ithi indlela imfundo ephakamileyo isabela ngayo kwi-AI evelisayo iyeka kwixesha elingephanga, ngelixa abafundi befumana izidanga kuphela, ngaphambi kokuba uvavanyo lwenyani lokugweba ngobungqina lufike. Liphononongo elenziwe ngo-2026, elipapashwe kwijenali i-Organization Science, laqwalasela abacebisi abangama-758 be-Boston Consulting Group abagqibezela imisebenzi yokwenyani benento okanye bengenayo incedisi ye-AI evelisayo: kwimisebenzi emininzi iqela elisebenzisa i-AI lasebenza ngokukhawuleza nangomgangatho ophezulu, kodwa kumsebenzi omnye ongaphaya kobuchule besixhobo, ama-70.6 ekhulwini kuphela abacebisi abasebenzisa i-AI abafikelela impendulo echanekileyo, kuxhomekeke kuma-84.5 ekhulwini kwabasebenza bengenayo, kwaye abahloli abangazaziyo iimpendulo bagqiba ukuba iingxelo ezingachanekileyo ze-AI zazibonakala zinyanisekile njengezo zichanekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI, isakhono sabafundi abaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, olu phononongo lubonisa ukuba umsebenzi wokusebenzisa i-AI ngokuzithemba kodwa ongachanekileyo ungabonakala unyanisekile njengowo uchanekileyo, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba kufuneka ukugweba ngobungqina, kungenjalo kuphela ulwazi lwe-AI, kuba sisakhono abaphumelele izidanga abasidinga ngakumbi phambi kokungena kwimarike yemisebenzi.

University World News · Established higher education press, commentary citing a peer-reviewed field experiment

entry.title: UNESCO and Codemao's AI coding drive reaches more African classrooms
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO kunye neplatform yeTshayina yokubhala iinkqubo zekhompyutha, i-Codemao, bathi iprojekthi yabo edibeneyo yokufundisa ulutsha ukubhala iinkqubo iyaqhubeka ikhula e-Afrika. Isigaba sesibini, esiya kuqhubeka kude kube ku-2030, sele sifundise ootitshala abangama-200 eRiphablikhi yaseCongo, eKenya, eNamibia naseThailand, apho ama-45% yabo ingabasetyhini, kwaye iKenya inikwe ii-tablet ezingama-200 kuzikolo zesekondari eziyama-20 ezimaphakathi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye nohlalutyo lwedatha kwimfundo yeSTEM kunye nemfundo yootitshala, le projekthi ibonisa umzekelo wokwakha izakhono ze-AI nokubhala iinkqubo zekhompyutha phakathi kootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi, ngokukodwa kubasetyhini.

Xinhua (New China TV) · Major international news agency, video report

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds AI chatbot use split with student learning outcomes
entry.summary:
Uvavanyo lwe-PISA 2025 lwe-OECD, olukuqala kukhangela ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, luvavanyile abafundi abangaphezu kwe-760,000 abaneminyaka yobudala eli-15 kumazwe ali-91. Lufumanise ukuba ukuxhomekeka ngokugqithisileyo kwii-chatbot ze-AI ukubhala umsebenzi wesikolo kunxulumene namanqaku aphantsi kwinzululwazi, ngelixa ukusetyenziswa okulinganiselweyo nokukhokelweyo kubonisa iipateni ezahlukileyo nezingcono; amanqaku okufunda nemathematika nawo awele kakhulu kumazwe e-OECD ekudeni leminyaka elishumi edlulileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, oku ngumqondiso wokuqala wendlela abafundi abaza kuyiphatha xa befikile kwiyunivesithi, nokuya kufuneka kufundiswe nokuvavanywe kuyo.

OECD (via Newsweek) · Intergovernmental body's flagship international assessment, reported by established press

entry.title: Understanding ethical dimensions of AI in higher education: insights from faculty members and students
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olusebenzisa iindlela ezixubeneyo lubuzile abafundi abali-971 kunye nabasebenzi bemfundo abali-135, emva koko lwenza udliwano-ndlebe nabafundi abali-23 nootitshala abali-14, malunga neendlela zokuziphatha ze-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo. Amaqela omabini ayavumelana ngokubanzi ukuba i-AI kufuneka isetyenziswe ngendlela enembopheleleko, kodwa iimbono zawo zahluka: ootitshala bagxininisa imigaqo yokuziphatha kodwa bathi iiziko zabo zisweleka izikhokelo, ngelixa abafundi bafumanisa i-AI iluncedo ekufundeni kodwa bengaqinisekile ukuba imbopheleleko yabo iyafikelela phi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, iingcebiso zoluphononongo, uqeqesho lwabasebenzi, izifundo zemigaqo yokuziphatha ezizimeleyo, kunye nezikhokelo zeyunivesithi ezicacileyo, zinika uluhlu olusebenzayo kumaziko angekabi nawo umgaqo-nkqubo osesikweni wemigaqo yokuziphatha ye-AI.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: From AI literacy to action: South Africa charts a path forward for teacher education
entry.summary:
ISebe lezemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqeshwa laseMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Commonwealth of Learning babambe inkomfa yoqeqesho yesizwe yeentsuku ezibini malunga ne-AI kwimfundo yootitshala, kwikampasi ye-Future Africa yeYunivesithi yasePitoli. Abafundisi-ntsapho, abenzi-mgaqo-nkqubo kunye neenkokeli zenkqubo bavumelana ngendlela yomgaqo-nkqubo wesizwe oguqukayo esekelwe kumgaqo, baze baseka iqela losebenzi lesizwe, iziphumo zinjongelwe ukufaka esihlolweni esiqhubekayo seMinimum Requirements for Teacher Education Qualifications, abathathi-nxaxheba baphawula ukuba ngoku asithethi nto malunga ne-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nemfundo yootitshala, oku kubonisa inkqubo ecacileyo, ekhokelwa ngurhulumente, eguqula ulwazi lwe-AI kube ngumgaqo-nkqubo wesizwe wamanqaku kwinkqubo yemfundo yootitshala yaseMzantsi Afrika.

Commonwealth of Learning · Intergovernmental organisation report on a national government workshop

entry.title: Supporting cost-effective AI adoption in education
entry.summary:
I-World Bank ipapashe iphepha lophando elithi Costing AI Use in Education in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, kunye nombhalo weblog ocacisa indlela amasebe ezemfundo afanele ahlele ngayo uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwe-AI. Licebisa ukuqalisa ngezixhobo ezinceda ootitshala, njengokucwangcisa izifundo kunye nokunika impendulo, kunokuba i-AI isasazwe kubafundi bonke ngaxeshanye, ukuthelekisa iindleko ze-AI kunye neendleko zamanje zokwandisa ufundisa oluqhelekileyo, nokusebenzisa izixhobo kunye nemithombo-nqaku yeselfowuni esele ikho ezikolweni. I-World Bank iqikelela ukuba ukufikelela kwinjongo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo lwezemfundo eMzantsi Afrika weSahara kuya kufuna ngaphezu koko i-6.4 bhiliyoni yeedola zaseMelika ngonyaka kootitshala bamabanga asezantsi kunye ne-38.7 bhiliyoni ngonyaka kootitshala bamabanga aphezulu kuzo i-2030.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nohlalutyo kunye nedatha ekhonza iinkqubo zemfundo nokuthatha izigqibo, le ngxelo inika amasebe kunye nemiziko kuMzantsi weHlabathi isakhelo esicacileyo, esinezindleko eziqikelelweyo, sokugqiba apho inkcitho ye-AI kwimfundo iya kuba luncedo olukhulu.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body blog, summarising a World Bank working paper

entry.title: Grappling with "homework scams", US universities shun AI detectors
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-AFP ethwelwe yi-eNCA ichaza indlela iYale, iCornell kunye neYunivesithi yaseWisconsin-Madison ezithethelela okanye ezithintela abasebenzi bazo ukusebenzisa isoftware yokufumanisa i-AI njengobungqina bokuqhatha, emva kokuba uphononongo lufumene ukuba ezi zixhobo azithembekile kwaye zidla ngokubonisa iziphumo ezingamampunge, kuquka nakubabhali abangathethi isiNgesi njengolwimi lwabo lwenzala. Umhlohli wezibalo zendalo eWisconsin-Madison, owafihla umyalelo kumsebenzi, wabamba abafundi 60 kwi-350 abasebenzisa i-AI bengabonwa ngoqinisekiso oluqhelekile, kwaye ngoku uguqukela kuviwo lwamazwi kunye neengxoxo-mpikiswano zevidiyo kunokubhalwa kweenkumbulo; uphononongo lwe-American Association of Colleges and Universities kunye neYunivesithi yaseElon lwafumanisa ukuba 95% yabahlohli boyika ukuxhomekeka ngokugqithisileyo kwabafundi kwi-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ngakumbi uvavanyo nengqibelelo yezemfundo, yiNtsika 1 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye lo mhlehlo kumasofthiwe okufumanisa i-AI kwiiyunivesithi eziphambili luphawu olungqalileyo, olunempumelelo yokuba iqela kufuneka licebise njani ngokuguqulwa kovavanyo kunoko kuxhomekeke kufumaniso njengempendulo kulo kusetyenziswa gwenxa kwe-AI.

AFP (via eNCA) · Established press (wire service report)

entry.title: Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026: Back to the Future
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-International Labour Organization, i-Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026, ifumanise ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho yolutsha ehlabathini lenyukele kuma-12.4% ngo-2025, ishiya malunga nezigidi 67 zolutsha oluneminyaka 15 ukuya ku-24 lungaphangeli, ngelixa malunga nomnye kwabahlanu abaselutsha, abalinganiselwa kwizigidi 257, bengekho emsebenzini, emfundweni okanye kuqeqesho. Ingxelo iqikelela ukuba 6.1% yemisebenzi egcinwe ngulutsha olusemaminyakeni 15 ukuya ku-29 isemngciphekweni omkhulu wokutshintshwa ngumsebenzi we-AI, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yeeofisi neyokubhala eyavakala yehlile kubasebenzi abaselutsha, kwaye ibongoza ulawulo lwe-AI kunye nobuchwepheshe olugxile ebantwini, ehamba kunye noxhaso olomeleleyo lokusingisa emsebenzini onesidima.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ukuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, equka indlela i-AI eguqula ngayo imisebenzi yamanqanaba okuqala, yiNtsika 4 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenweyo yile ngxelo yamazwe ngamazwe, ukuba imisebenzi yeeofisi, edla ngokuba inyathelo lokuqala kwabaphumelele izidanga, isemngciphekweni omkhulu kwi-AI, inika iqela umqathango oqinisekileyo nowehlabathi lemisebenzi yalo malunga ne-AI nokuqesheka kwabaphumelele izidanga kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

International Labour Organization · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Generative AI use and misuse call for assessment reform in higher education
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluhlolwe ziingcali kwijenali ye-Science luphendlwe abafundi abangaphezu kwe-95,000 kwiiyunivesithi 20 ezinkulu zoluntu zophando eMelika, ngonyaka wezifundo we-2023-24. Lufumene ukuba 37% yabafundi basebenzisa i-AI evelisayo ubuncinane kwixesha elinye ngenyanga kumsebenzi wabo, kwaye ababhali baqikelela ukuba malunga ne-9% bayisebenzisela ukuqhatha, inani eli linyukela kuma-26% phakathi kwabasebenzisi bemihla ngemihla; ukusetyenziswa nokuqhatha kwahluka kakhulu ngokuxhomekeke kwisifundo. Ababhali babongoza utshintsho lovavanyo olufanelekileyo kwisifundo ngasinye kunokuba kubekho ukuvalwa okubanzi okanye inkqubo yokufumanisa kwiyunivesithi iphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ngakumbi uvavanyo nengqibelelo yezemfundo, yiNtsika 1 ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenweyo kolu phononongo lukhulu, ukuba ukusetyenziswa gwenxa kwahluka ngokwesifundo kungabi kufana kuzo zonke, kunika iqela ubungqina obuqinisekileyo bokuyila utshintsho lovavanyo olufanelekileyo kwisifundo ngasinye, kunokuba kubekho inguqu yonke jikelele.

Science · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UCT summit puts AI, inequality and future of universities in spotlight
entry.summary:
Inkomfa yeHlabathi yeZemfundo ePhakamileyo ye-Times Higher Education ivulwe kwi-University of Cape Town ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026, okukuqala i-Afrika ibambe le nkomfa. Abantu abangama-600 abangabaphathi bezemfundo ephakamileyo, iingcali kunye nabenzi bomgaqo-nkqubo abavela kumazwe angaphezu kwama-60 bathatha inxaxheba; iSekela loMlawuli kwi-UCT, uNjingalwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe ikamva leyunivesithi alinakucuthwa nje ekwamkeleni itekhnoloji; ngelixa uMphathiswa weZemfundo ePhakamileyo, uButi Manamela, ebiza ukuba i-AI yandise ukufikelela kwimfundo, kuxhaswe ngulwazi olubanzi malunga ne-AI kunye nokufikelela okungcono kwitekhnoloji. I-UCT iyekile ukuxhomekeka kwiisofthiwe zokufumanisa i-AI, kunoko yakha uhlaka lwayo malunga nendlela abafundi nabasebenzi abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI evelisayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ukufikelela kwi-AI evelisayo ngokulinganayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo yintsika yokuqala kwiintsika ezintandathu ze-Wits AHEAD, kwaye umphathiswa echaza ulwazi nge-AI, kungekhe yiisofthiwe zokufumanisa, njengemeko yokufikelela okulinganayo, kuhambelana ncam nommandla osetyenziswa ngumsebenzi womgaqo-nkqubo nokufundisa weli qela.

TimesLIVE · Established press

entry.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
entry.summary:
I-Global Index on Responsible AI ka-2026, epapashwe yi-Global Center on AI Governance kwaye yasungulwa eGeneva ngoJulayi 2026, ihlole ulawulo kumazwe ali-135 isebenzisa amanqaku edatha angaphezu kwe-68,000 aqokelelwe phakathi kweNovemba 2023 kunye neSeptemba 2025. Ifumanise ukuba amazwe ali-126 kwali-135 anomgaqo-nkqubo okanye icebo elinye lorhulumente malunga ne-AI enoxanduva, nangona lo bambiselano lucutha ukuba luguqukele kukhuselo olunamandla; ulwazi nge-AI lube phakathi kwezibonakalisi ezisebenze kakuhle, amazwe ama-71, ipesenti 53, exela ukuba analo uhlaka olusebenzayo, ngokuchaseneyo namazwe ambalwa ngakumbi anamaziko ajongana nokubeka iliso ezizimeleyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo yintsika yesithandathu ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye okufunyenwe kolu luhlu, ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo yolwazi nge-AI ihamba ngesantya esikhulu kunamaziko anamandla okuyinyanzelisa, kuchaza ngqo umsantsa wolawulo apho umsebenzi womgaqo-nkqubo weli qela ulinge ukuwuvala kwimfundo ephakamileyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

entry.title: Preparing future STEM educators: investigating artificial intelligence literacy among pre-service STEM teachers
entry.summary:

Ootitshala baxele inqanaba eliphezulu ngesiseko sawonke-wonke lolwazi nge-AI, kwaye ulwazi nokuqonda kwabo nge-AI kuqikelele ngokuphawulekayo indlela abaye basebenzisa ngayo emva koko; uphononongo luphinde lwafumana umahluko ophawulekayo ngokwesini kulwazi nge-AI, othambekele kumadoda.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: I-AI kunye nohlalutyo lwedatha kwi-STEM nemfundo yootitshala yintsika yesithathu ye-Wits AHEAD, kwaye lo mahluko wesini ofunyenweyo phakathi kootitshala abaqeqeshelwa eLagos luphawu olungqalileyo lwendlela iinkqubo zoqeqesho lootitshala kuMzantsi weHlabathi ekufanele ziyile ngayo ukulungiselela kwazo i-AI.

entry.title: Keeping the learning real: an integrated approach to academic integrity in the age of AI
entry.summary:
I-Wonkhe kunye nenkonzo yovavanyo i-Studiosity baphonononge imigaqo-nkqubo yeeyunivesithi zaseBritane, baze babambe iingxoxo neenkokeli zeziko kunye nabafundi ngoSeptemba 2026 ngengqibelelo yezemfundo ngexesha le-AI evelisayo. Ingxelo, epapashwe ngomhla we-4 kuOktobha 2026, ifumanisa ukuba amaziko ayeka ukugcina umthetho ngokusebenzisa izixhobo zokufumanisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, aze agxile kwindlela yovavanyo eguqulweyo, ukufundiswa ngolwazi lwe-AI, kunye neendlela ezingohlwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukufunda kwenzeke ngokwenyani. Ichaphazela ukuba inkqubo yengqibelelo yezemfundo isengena kuhambelana, ayikabi nokuthenjwa ngabafundi, abangathandabuzekiyo ukuba amaziko aya kuwakholelwa amazwi abo ngendlela abawasebenzise ngayo i-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, oku kuyingxelo enabileyo yakutsha nje ebonisa indlela inkqubo yemfundo ephakamileyo enkulu eguqula ngayo uvavanyo kunokuba izame ukufumanisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, ize inikeze isakhelo esisebenzayo sesikhokelo kubaphathiswa nabafundi.

entry.title: Digital solidification: learning analytics, the panopticon, and data coloniality in South African higher education

Iphepha alithatheli ingozi uhlalutyo lokufunda njengoluyingozi ngokwalo, kodwa lilumkisa ukuba iiflegi ezingaphindwa ziphononongwe okanye zihlaziywe zenza nzulu imeko yoMzantsi Afrika engalingani ngokwendalo nangolwimi. Liphakamisa uhlaka olujoliswe kubulungisa boluntu, olusekelwe kwimanyano yedata, uphononongo olubandakanya abafundi kwi-algorithm, kunye nokutolikwa kweeflegi ngokweemeko njengesikhuthazo sokuxhasa kunokuba zibe isohlwayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo ngumbono ophandwe ziingcali ngokuthe ngqo waseMzantsi Afrika ogxeka izixhobo zohlalutyo oluqikelelayo eziphambili kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI noHlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, unika intsika yeqela ye-AI ethembekileyo, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nolingano iinkqubo zokhuseleko ezisekelwe phambi kokucebisa ngeenkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba.

entry.title: Helpful or harmful? Generative AI dependence, self-reported critical thinking disposition, and self-perceived employability among business students

Ukusetyenziswa okukhulu kwe-AI kudibaniswe nokuqesheka okuziva ngakho okuphakamileyo, kodwa ukuxhomekeka ngaphezulu kwe-AI kudibaniswe nokucinga ngobunzulu okubuthathaka, kuze kubuthathe amandla ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwe-AI nokuqesheka, kuse kwinqanaba apho kungabi nabungakanani kokuxhomekeka okuphezulu. Ababhali bagqiba ngokuthi inzuzo ixhomekeke kukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngokucingisisa nangokuqinisekisa, kungenjalo kubukhulu bokusetyenziswa, nangona uyilo lwemibuzo ezichaza ngokwazo nolwexesha elinye luthintela amabango ngokubangelana.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kuthetha kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga kunye nokuqesheka, kubonisa ukuba ukuxhomekeka ngaphandle kokuqwalasela kwi-AI kunganomngcipheko wokonakalisa loo masakhono acingwa ngabaqeshi, isilumkiso esibalulekileyo kwinkqubo zokuqesheka kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

entry.title: Assessment practices resistant to inappropriate AI use in Open Distance eLearning: insights from Zimbabwe Open University
entry.summary:

Bafumanise ukuba uvavanyo olusekwe kumsebenzi wokwenza, olucingisisayo, olumlomo kunye nolujongwe ngononophelo kwiinqanaba zokufundisa, lubonwa njengolunzima ngakumbi ukuqhathwa ngendlela engenyanisekileyo ngokusebenzisa i-AI, nangona oku kuphakamisa inkxalabo ngomthwalo womsebenzi wootitshala kunye nobungakanani bamakilasi. Ababhali balumkisa ukuba iziphumo ezivela ekhampasini enye yommandla azinakwenza isigwebo ngeziko liphela okanye ngemfundo yokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude ngokubanzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kunika imbono yoMzantsi weHlabathi kunye nemfundo yokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude ngokwakhiwa kwakhona kovavanyo ukulwa ukusetyenziswa kakubi kwe-AI evelisayo, kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nto ebalulekileyo ngokuthe ngqo kwinkqubo zokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude kuyo yonke lo mmandla.

entry.title: Automated software scoring of senior school certificate examination mathematical items in economics using a contextual similarity model

entry.title: Tshwane University of Technology dialogue presses South Africa to move from AI strategy to implementation

Umlawuli ophambili Tseliso Mohlomi uthi uMzantsi Afrika kufuneka udlule kwisicwangciso nengxoxo yokusebenzisa i-AI, ekhankanya ukhuseleko lwe-cyber, i-cloud computing, ukufunda i-AI kunye nobunjineli bedatha njengoobalulekileyo ekufuneka kwenziwe kwangoko. entry.title: Liberia advances a national education data system to inform real-time decisions

entry.summary:
Phambi kwe-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit, ebanjwe yi-University of Cape Town ukususela nge-29 Septemba ukuya kwi-1 Okthobha, eyokuqala ukubanjelwa emhlabeni wase-Afrika, i-SABC News ibuza ukuba iyunivesithi kufuneka ibe njani njengoko i-AI itshintsha indlela abantu abasebenza ngayo, abafunda ngayo nabavelisa ngayo ulwazi. ISekela leNqununu kwiZophando noBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe e-UCT, uNjingalwazi Thokozani Majozi, uxoxa ngomxholo wale ngqungquthela, "Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence", kunye nendima yeeyunivesithi engaphaya kokuvelisa abaphumelele izidanga.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, izakhono zabaphumelele izidanga nokuguquka kwabo besiya emsebenzini, umbuzo wale ngqungquthela wokuba iiyunivesithi zinoxanduva lwantoni kubaphumelele izidanga nakuluntu njengoko i-AI iguqula umsebenzi ngumbuzo weqela ngokwalo, ngoku obuzwa kwiqonga laseMzantsi Afrika.

SABC News · SABC News (public broadcaster)

entry.title: African scholarship is building a decolonial agenda for AI in university classrooms, systematic review finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucwangcisiweyo kwijenali ye-Trends in Higher Education luhlalutya izifundo ezingama-25 ukususela ngo-2010 ukuya ku-2025 malunga nokupheliswa kobukoloniyali (decoloniality), ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa kunye namagumbi okufundela eyunivesithi kwimfundo ephakamileyo yase-Afrika. Ukupapashwa kukhawuleze emva ko-2020 kujikeleze imixholo emithathu, ukungabikho kobulungisa kulwazi kunye nekharityhulam, ubukoloniyali be-algorithm kunye nokuxhatshazwa kwedatha, kunye notshintsho ekufundiseni olufunwa yi-AI evelisayo, uphando lugxile kakhulu eMzantsi Afrika, kukho nomsebenzi osakhulayo welizwekazi lase-Afrika liphela kwi-AI yeelwimi zase-Afrika. Ababhali bafumanisa ukuba kukho inkqubo yophando lwe-AI yokupheliswa kobukoloniyali ehambelanayo esakhiwayo, kodwa ukuza kuthi ga ngoku bubuncinane ubungqina obusekelwe kuphando lwasebaleni.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, luchaza imibuzo yokuba lulwazi lukabani neelwimi zikabani i-AI ezizisa kumagumbi okufundela ase-Afrika, lubonise nokuba isiseko sobungqina sisebhityile kangakanani, isikhewu uphando kwi-Wits School of Education olunokunceda ukusivala.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: AI emerges as a distinct part of the student academic experience in a survey of 2,403 Bolivian undergraduates
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabafundi bezidanga zokuqala abangama-2,403 kwiyunivesithi yabucala e-Bolivia, olupapashwe kwijenali ye-Education Sciences, luqinisekisa ukuthembeka koluhlu lwemibuzo olunezinto ezingama-31 malunga namava ezemfundo, kwaye lufumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ekufundeni kwabo, njengoko kuxelwa ngabafundi, kulicandelo elahlukileyo ecaleni kokuzibandakanya, ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, umgangatho wokufundisa nokuzinikela. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI okuxelweyo kwakunonxulumano oluhle nokuzibandakanya kwezemfundo kunye nezakhono zonxibelelwano, zokuziphatha nezokucinga ngokuhlalutya; ababhali bagxininisa ukuba esi sixhobo silinganisa iimbono, hayi iziphumo zokufunda.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, isixhobo esiqinisekisiweyo saseMzantsi weHlabathi esijonga ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI njengenxalenye yendlela abafundi abafumana ngayo amava eyunivesithi sisixhobo esiluncedo iqela elinokusilungiselela uphando lwezimvo zabafundi eMzantsi Afrika, kunye nesilumkiso sababhali sokuba silinganisa iimbono, hayi ukufunda.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Oxford let OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts, the Guardian reports
entry.summary:
Amaxwebhu angaphakathi afunyenwe liphephandaba The Guardian abonisa ukuba iYunivesithi yaseOxford ivumele i-OpenAI ukuguqula iimbalo zembali ze-Bodleian Library yayo zibe nkqubo yeedijithali, kubandakanya iiskena ezingama-125,000 zeethisisi zobugqirha zenkulungwane yeshumi elinethoba kunye neyamashumi amabini, kunye neengoma zasesitratweni ezili-10,000 zexesha lase-Tudor, ukunceda ukuqeqeshwa kweemodeli zayo ze-AI. Ubambiswano lwaseOxford nee-OpenAI, olwaziswa ngo-2025, lwaziswa njengeprojekti yokwandisa ukufikelela kwiimbalo ezinqabileyo; akwaziswanga ukuba ezi skena ziya kusetyenziselwa ulwazi lokuqeqesha lwee-OpenAI. Amanqaku entlanganiso angaphakathi abonisa ukuba amalungu ekomiti yolawulo abonakalise inkxalabo ngomngcipheko kwimfaneleko kunye nendleko yamandla ye-AI, ngelixa iOxford ithi loo mbalo mncinci ngomlinganiselo, awusekho phantsi kwamalungelo omlinganiso, kwaye uya kupapashwa kwi-intanethi kwiinyanga ezizayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Ntsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, lo mcimbi ulumkiso kuyunivesithi nokuba iyiyiphi, nokuba kusemazantsi eHlabathi okanye eOxford, evumela inkampani ye-AI ukuphatha iimbalo okanye ulwazi lwayo: ngaphandle kwesaziso esicacileyo soluntu malunga nendlela imbalo iya kusetyenziswa ngayo, iprojekti yokufikelela yokwenyani inokubonakala, emva koko, ngathi sisivumelwano esifihlakeleyo sokunikezela ulwazi, nokuyiyona ntsasa yokusungululeka u-Wits AHEAD ebongoza amaziko ukuba avale ngaphambi kokutyikitya.

The Guardian (Ethan Penny and Dan Milmo) · Established press investigation

entry.title: University of Ghana approves an AI policy and a compulsory digital literacy course for every student
entry.summary:
IBhunga leYunivesithi yaseGhana lamkele umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI oya kusetyenziswa kwiyunivesithi iphela, owenziwe emva kwenjongo yokuphononongo yangaphakathi efumene izikhewu kuqeqesho, ukufikelela okulinganiselweyo kwizixhobo ze-AI, kunye neenkxalabo malunga nokuchaneka, ingqibelelo yezemfundo kunye nemigaqo yokuziphatha. Ekubikeni oku kumsitho wokuphothula iziqu eAccra, apho abafundi abali-1,884 baphothule, isekela-rector, uNjingalwazi Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, wathi iyunivesithi iya kuphinda ifune kumfundi ngamnye, ukususela unyaka wezifundo olandelayo, ukuthatha ikhosi entsha enyanzelekileyo yolwazi lwedijithali kunye ne-AI esetyenzisiweyo, ihamba kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo owahlukeneyo wokufundisa nokufunda.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, indlela iyunivesithi karhulumente ehambela kwimixholo yesikhokelo ukusa kwikhosi enyanzelekileyo yolwazi lwe-AI kumphumelele ngamnye, isekelwe kubungqina bayo yakwayena ngeendawo abafundi nabasebenzi abasokola kuzo, luhlobo lwempendulo elihlelwe kwaye elisebenzisa iyunivesithi iphela elikhangelwayo nguWits AHEAD ngaphesheya kwemveliso, kunye nokungabi migaqo-nkqubo ihleli kuphela kwiphepha.

University of Ghana (policy document); Ghanaian Times · University policy document

entry.title: OECD finds generative AI use nearly universal in higher education but only one in five institutions has a formal policy
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-OECD, ethi Policies supporting responsible and systematic GenAI adoption in higher education, epapashwe kuluhlu lwe-OECD Education Spotlights, ifumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI evelisayo phakathi kwabafundi beyunivesithi kuphantse kwaba yinto yabantu bonke, kunyuka ukusuka kuma-66 ekhulu abafundi baseBritane ngo-2024 ukuya kuma-95 ekhulu ngo-2026, kunyuka nama-86 ekhulu abafundi kuphononongo olwenziwe emazweni ali-16. Noko ke, ngama-19 ekhulu kuphela amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo emhlabeni jikelele abanomgaqo-nkqubo osesikweni we-AI evelisayo ngo-2025, nangona ama-42 ekhulu ngaphezulu ayilungiselela, kwaye ngama-17 ekhulu kuphela abasebenzi bezemfundo emhlabeni jikelele ababalwa njengabasebenzisi abaphambili okanye iingcali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, umsantsa oqikelelwa i-OECD, phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwemihla ngemihla okuphantse kwaba yemizekelo yabantu bonke kunye nolawulo olusesikweni kuyunivesithi enye kwaye zintlanu, yiyo kanye isantsa u-Wits AHEAD awasekwa ukunceda ukuvala, kunye nomkhumbuzo wokuba ukwamkela izixhobo ze-AI kunye nokulawula kunoxanduva ngumsebenzi omibini owahlukeneyo oninzi lwayunivesithi lingekawuphethi nalinye lwayo.

University World News (Karen MacGregor), reporting an OECD report · Intergovernmental research report, reported by established press

entry.title: African universities urged to collaborate and use AI responsibly, Times Higher Education summit hears
entry.summary:
KwiTimes Higher Education World Academic Summit eKapa, umphathi wophuhliso lwamashishini weinhlangano kummandla waseMzantsi weSahara, uMosebjadi Petje, ubize amayunivesithi aseAfrika ukuba abelane ngeenkqubo zophando nobuchule ukujamelana nemiceli mngeni eqhelekileyo efana notshintsho lwemozulu kunye nentswela-ngqesho yolutsha, kwaye ukwamkela i-AI "ngoxanduva" kunokuyala. Ukwakhuthaze amaziko ukuba asebenzise idatha yawo siqu ukwenza izigqibo zenkqubela, kungekhona kuphela ukubonwa kuluhlu, ethetha kubathunywa abasuka kumayunivesithi angaphaya kwama-55 aseMzantsi weSahara akwiTimes Higher Education World University Rankings.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, isibongozo esivela ngaphakathi kwicandelo lamayunivesithi aseAfrika ngokwalo sokwabelana ngeenkqubo nokusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngoxanduva, kunokuba kulandelwe imimiselo ethathwe kwamanye amazwe, sihambelana ngokuthe ngqo nendlela yentsebenziswano eholwa yiAfrika uWits AHEAD ewusebenzisayo kulawulo lwe-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo.

Channel Africa (SABC international service) · Established broadcaster

entry.title: US unemployment rate for university graduates falls to 2.5%, lowest of any education group, official data show
entry.summary:
I-United States Bureau of Labor Statistics ixela ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho kubantu abane-digri okanye ngaphezulu lehla lisa kuma-2.5% ngoSeptemba 2026, kusuka ku-2.7% ngoAgasti, lihlala lisezantsi kunawo onke amaqela emfundo abawalandelelayo. Ingxelo, i-USDL-26-1549, ikwabonisa ukuba intswela-ngqesho kubasebenzi abangenayo imfundo yeyunivesithi ihlala iphezulu ngamaphesenti ambalwa ngengxowa enye.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, i-AI, ubuchule babaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, idata esisiseko yase-US ebonisa umsantsa wentswela-ngqesho uphinda wenziwa banzi ngabo banedigri, ikhumbuza ukuba, nangona i-AI itshintsha ukuqeshwa kokuqala emhlabeni wonke, idigri yeyunivesithi isahlinzeka ngenzuzo enyanisekileyo kumsebenzi, nto leyo uphando lwe-Wits AHEAD ngokuqesheka oluvavanya kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation News Release (September 2026) · National statistics office

entry.title: UCT vice-chancellor says all students will be trained to use AI, not banned from it
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwiTimes Higher Education World Academic Summit eKapa, isekela-rector yeYunivesithi yaseKapa, uNjingalwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe iyunivesithi iwele kuthintela ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI eveliswayo ukusa kuqeqeshweni kwabo bonke abafundi ukuba bayisebenzise ngoxanduva, kumanqanaba awohlukeneyo. I-UCT iyekile ukuxhomekeka kwiinqheliso zokuchonga i-AI ukubeka iliso kumsebenzi wabafundi, kwaye ngoku iyijonga i-AI, ngamazwi akhe, njenge "iqabane kwiprojekti yokufundisa nokufunda". Iyunivesithi ikwasebenza ukwenza izixhobo ze-AI zifikelele ngaphandle kwekhampasi, kuba izixhobo zorhwebo zisasele zibiza kakhulu kuluntu oluninzi kweli lizwekazi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, utshintsho olu lusuka kubeka iliso kusetyenziswa kwe-AI ukusa kuqeqeshweni kwabo bonke abafundi ngumqondiso ocacileyo kakhulu wokuba iyunivesithi enkulu yoMzantsi weHlabathi ngoku ijonga ulwazi lwe-AI njengobuchule obusisiseko kwabaphumelele izidanga, kungenjalo ingxaki yesiyalo, isicwangciso umsebenzi wePolisi yeWits AHEAD kuvavanyo nokunyaniseka osilandela ngokusondeleyo.

University of Cape Town News (story by Niémah Davids) · University announcement
